authority.process: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0
sources: G4-07 source-authorization SRC-24, COL-THERM D0 read-only thermal zone attrs, 8 MiB, <=2048 entries, 4s, no trip/cooling policy writes
G4-02/06 Source Evidence Map SRC-24 deterministic original artifact identities
Accepted G5-03 passive_worker.py SRC-24 ROOTS, ATTRS, source_paths and item ordinal mapping

path_contract.within_zone_order: The worker's fixed ATTRS tuple, type then temp (NOT alphabetical sorted)
path_contract.source_paths: Only successfully sealed file paths, mapped ordinally to item0001..itemNNNN; missing optional values reported unavailable_fields and not fabricated.

unit_semantics.type: bounded single-line UTF-8 thermal zone type label; unknown labels preserved text, no inferred sensor class
unit_semantics.temp: signed decimal integer reported in millidegrees Celsius (m°C). Preserve recorded integer, do not divide by 1000 or fabricate calibrated Celsius.

cases.expected: two sealed thermal_zone0 type/temp originals mapped to distinct typed private fields; correct unit millidegrees Celsius; manifest and SHA validate
thermal_zone10 listed lexically before thermal_zone2; separate originals never conflated
missing temp optional field is reported unavailable without invented temperature; no zones reported means zero observations
receipt path count, duplicate/reordered attrs or zones, mismatched ordinal all reject before manifest
/sys/class/thermal/cooling_device0, trip_point_0_temp, wrong root, traversal, fake thermal_zoneX reject without host access
cross-run or modified original evidence never normalized as verified
malformed decimal, out-of-range integer, embedded NUL, invalid UTF-8, multi-line source -> actual parser failure with lossless raw fallback
legitimate negative or zero millidegree value remains signed integer, not assumed Celsius or normal operating temperature
unfamiliar type label retained as original text; no thermal health recommendation or limits inferred

limitations: Source-first oracle specified independently of parser code but by SAME AI; no independent human signoff. Scope excludes cooling writes, power management, reporting, privacy mask, host validation and requirements-wide verification.
